text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner of 38 Grasspoint Crescent to maintain the existing rear yard board on board fence, which does not meet all of the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.
Etobicoke York Community Council deferred consideration of this Item to its meeting on May 2, 2018.
